---
title: "g:profiler example"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}
library(gprofiler2)
```

```{r}
query <- read.delim("genelist.txt", header = F)
query <- query[, 1]
enres <- gost(
  query,
  organism = "hsapiens",
  ordered_query = FALSE,
  multi_query = FALSE,
  significant = TRUE,
  exclude_iea = FALSE,
  measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
  evcodes = TRUE,
  user_threshold = 0.05,
  correction_method = "fdr",
  domain_scope = "annotated",
  custom_bg = NULL,
  numeric_ns = "",
  sources = c("GO:BP", "REAC", "WP"),
  as_short_link = FALSE,
  highlight = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
gostplot(enres, capped = TRUE, interactive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
TFEC_inds <- grep("TFEC", (enres[["result"]][["intersection"]]))
TFEC_terms <- paste(enres[["result"]][["source"]][TFEC_inds], enres[["result"]][["term_name"]][TFEC_inds], enres[["result"]][["p_value"]][TFEC_inds], sep = ", ")
TFEC_terms
```
